headline: Application role gains read/write access to every S3 bucket in the account instead of just acme-prod-data
suppressed: The stated operational problem is real — needing to manually add bucket ARNs when analytics creates new ones — but the solution of blanket access to all S3 buckets is far too broad. A better path would be to change how new buckets are tagged or named so they match a pattern in the policy, or to automate the variable update.

findings.explanation: The application role now has unrestricted S3 read/write access across all buckets in the account instead of being limited to the specific acme-prod-data bucket. This violates least-privilege and exposes all company data to the application role's scope.
